name: Credicorp LTD
description: Credicorp Ltd is a Peruvian financial services company. The company operates in four business lines, including Universal Banking, Insurance and Retirement, Microfinance, and Investment Banking and Asset Management. Its subsidiaries include Banco de Credito del Peru, Prima AFP, Credicorp Capital, and others. Geographically, the company operates in Peru, Colombia, Bolivia, Chile, Panama, the USA, and Mexico; the majority of its revenue is generated from Peru.
